summary: Based on evidence through August 6 2020, all assumptions regarding timely reporting, VIP acquisition performance, and absence of material adverse effect remain valid or insufficient to warrant changes; thus the existing covenant package is retained without modification.

clauses.rationale: No evidence shows the First Lien Net Leverage Ratio covenant is insufficient; leverage remains low and no breach indicated.
Timely delivery of annual financial statements is supported by assumption R03-A04; no evidence of delay.
Quarterly reporting assumption R03-A04 supported; no evidence of missed deadlines.
Monthly reporting assumption R03-A04 supported; no evidence of missed deadlines.
Assumption R03-A05 weakened due to COVID-19 closures, but the MAE notice clause already covers such events; no evidence of notice failure.
Indebtedness incurred for acquisitions remains within permitted baskets; no evidence of excess or breach.

drift_reasons: No dated evidence justifies tightening, loosening, or adding protections; all assumptions either supported, weakened but already addressed, or insufficient to drive change.
